o: My house is bigger than yours.
a: Your house is smaller than mine.
v: Your house is not as big as mine.
e: Doi chu the va dao tinh tu sang trai nghia: bigger thanh smaller.
m: Giu nguyen bigger o cau moi
c: is smaller than mine.

o: This exercise is easier than that one.
a: That exercise is more difficult than this one.
v: That exercise is harder than this one.
e: easy dao thanh more difficult (hoac harder).
c: is more difficult than this one.

o: Nam is taller than Minh.
a: Minh is shorter than Nam.
v: Minh is not as tall as Nam.
e: taller dao thanh shorter hoac not as tall as.
c: is shorter than Nam.

o: My bike is newer than yours.
a: Your bike is older than mine.
e: newer dao thanh older, yours/mine phai doi theo chu the moi.
c: is older than mine.

o: Today is colder than yesterday.
a: Yesterday was warmer than today.
e: Chu the la ngay da qua nen dung was, colder dao thanh warmer.
c: was warmer than today.

o: She speaks English better than me.
a: I do not speak English as well as her.
v: I speak English worse than her.
e: better dao thanh not as well as, chu the doi sang I.
m: Dung as good as (sai tu loai trang tu)
c: do not speak English as well as her.

o: This is the longest river in Vietnam.
a: No other river in Vietnam is as long as this one.
e: So sanh nhat chuyen thanh No other... as...as.
m: Dung longer sau No other river
c: in Vietnam is as long as this one.

o: He is the best student in my class.
a: No one in my class is better than him.
v: No one in my class is as good as him.
e: best (so sanh nhat cua good) chuyen thanh better than moi nguoi con lai.
c: in my class is better than him.

o: My room is not as big as yours.
a: Your room is bigger than mine.
e: Bo not as...as, dung bigger than va doi mine/yours.
m: Lap lai not as big o cau moi
c: is bigger than mine.

o: The red car is faster than the blue one.
a: The blue car is slower than the red one.
v: The blue car is not as fast as the red one.
e: faster dao thanh slower.
c: is slower than the red one.

o: Maths is more interesting than history.
a: History is less interesting than maths.
v: History is not as interesting as maths.
e: more interesting dao thanh less interesting.
m: Dung more boring khi de khong cho ngu canh chan chan (van chap nhan lam bien the phu neu thay duyet)
c: is less interesting than maths.

o: This is the most expensive phone in the shop.
a: No phone in the shop is as expensive as this one.
e: most expensive chuyen thanh No phone... as expensive as.
m: Dung the most expensive sau No phone
c: in the shop is as expensive as this one.

o: Tom works harder than John.
a: John does not work as hard as Tom.
v: John works less hard than Tom.
e: harder dao thanh does not work as hard as.
c: does not work as hard as Tom.

o: My sister is younger than me.
a: I am older than my sister.
e: younger dao thanh older khi doi chu the sang I.
m: Dung am younger than my sister
c: am older than my sister.

o: This street is narrower than that one.
a: That street is wider than this one.
e: narrower dao thanh wider.
c: is wider than this one.

o: He drives more carefully than his brother.
a: His brother does not drive as carefully as him.
v: His brother drives more carelessly than him.
e: more carefully dao thanh does not drive as carefully as.
c: does not drive as carefully as him.

o: Summer is hotter than spring.
a: Spring is cooler than summer.
v: Spring is not as hot as summer.
e: hotter dao thanh cooler.
c: is cooler than summer.

o: This is the tallest building in our town.
a: No building in our town is as tall as this one.
e: tallest chuyen thanh No building... as tall as.
c: in our town is as tall as this one.

o: I am not as strong as my father.
a: My father is stronger than me.
e: Dao chieu: bo not as...as thanh stronger than.
c: is stronger than me.

o: The first question is easier than the second one.
a: The second question is more difficult than the first one.
v: The second question is harder than the first one.
e: easier dao thanh more difficult / harder.
c: is more difficult than the first one.

o: The box is too heavy for me to lift.
a: The box is not light enough for me to lift.
e: too heavy chuyen thanh not light enough, giu for me to lift.
c: light enough for me to lift.

o: She is too young to drive a car.
a: She is not old enough to drive a car.
e: too young thanh not old enough.
c: old enough to drive a car.

o: The coffee is too hot for us to drink.
a: The coffee is not cool enough for us to drink.
e: too hot thanh not cool enough.
m: Dung not cold enough (nghia lech - chap nhan lam bien the neu thay duyet)
c: cool enough for us to drink.

o: He ran too slowly to catch the bus.
a: He did not run fast enough to catch the bus.
e: too slowly thanh did not run fast enough.
c: fast enough to catch the bus.

o: The lesson is too difficult for them to understand.
a: The lesson is not easy enough for them to understand.
e: too difficult thanh not easy enough.
c: easy enough for them to understand.

o: It was such a cold day that we stayed at home.
a: The day was so cold that we stayed at home.
e: such a cold day chuyen thanh so cold, bo danh tu day khoi vi tri tinh tu.
c: so cold that we stayed at home.

o: It was such an interesting film that we watched it twice.
a: The film was so interesting that we watched it twice.
e: such an interesting film thanh so interesting.
c: so interesting that we watched it twice.

o: The bag was so heavy that I could not carry it.
a: It was such a heavy bag that I could not carry it.
e: so heavy chuyen nguoc thanh such a heavy bag.
c: a heavy bag that I could not carry it.

o: He speaks too fast for us to follow.
a: He speaks so fast that we cannot follow him.
e: too fast for us to follow thanh so fast that we cannot follow him.
m: Giu nguyen for us to follow sau so fast
c: fast that we cannot follow him.

o: The room is too small for ten people to sit in.
a: The room is not big enough for ten people to sit in.
e: too small thanh not big enough, giu gioi tu in o cuoi.
m: Bo mat in o cuoi cau
c: big enough for ten people to sit in.

o: As he practised more, he played the piano better.
a: The more he practised, the better he played the piano.
e: As + hai ve cung tang chuyen thanh The more... the better...
m: Dung The more he practised, he played better
c: he practised, the better he played the piano.

o: If you study harder, you will get better marks.
a: The harder you study, the better marks you will get.
e: Dieu kien tang tien chuyen thanh so sanh kep voi will o ve hai.
c: you study, the better marks you will get.

o: He is too short to reach the shelf.
a: He is not tall enough to reach the shelf.
e: too short thanh not tall enough.
c: tall enough to reach the shelf.

o: It was such a long story that I could not finish it in one day.
a: The story was so long that I could not finish it in one day.
e: such a long story thanh so long.
c: so long that I could not finish it in one day.

o: The question was so easy that every student could answer it.
a: It was such an easy question that every student could answer it.
e: so easy chuyen thanh such an easy question (an vi easy bat dau bang nguyen am).
c: an easy question that every student could answer it.

o: As he gets older, he becomes wiser.
a: The older he gets, the wiser he becomes.
e: As... chuyen thanh The older... the wiser..., dong tu gets/becomes giu nguyen.
c: he gets, the wiser he becomes.

o: The knife is too blunt for me to cut the bread.
a: The knife is not sharp enough for me to cut the bread.
e: too blunt (cun) thanh not sharp enough.
c: sharp enough for me to cut the bread.

o: He is such a careful driver that he has never had an accident.
a: He drives so carefully that he has never had an accident.
e: Cum danh tu careful driver chuyen thanh dong tu + trang tu drives so carefully.
c: so carefully that he has never had an accident.

o: If the price is higher, fewer people will buy it.
a: The higher the price is, the fewer people will buy it.
e: Gia cang cao, nguoi mua cang it: The higher... the fewer...
m: Dung the less people (people dem duoc nen dung fewer)
c: the price is, the fewer people will buy it.

o: It was such a difficult test that most students failed.
a: The test was too difficult for most students to pass.
e: such a difficult test... failed chuyen thanh too difficult for most students to pass (doi failed thanh pass cho khop cau truc too).
m: Giu nguyen failed sau too difficult (sai nghia cau truc)
c: difficult for most students to pass.

o: It was such a difficult exercise that we couldn't do it.
a: The exercise was too difficult for us to do.
v: The exercise was so difficult that we couldn't do it.
e: such...that chuyen sang too...to, chu the we thanh for us.
m: Dung too difficult that hoac thieu for us
c: too difficult for us to do.

o: Nowadays young people pay more attention to traditional festivals than they did some years ago.
a: Some years back young people paid less attention to traditional festivals than they do nowadays.
e: Cau dao: chu the giu young people, qua khu dung paid less... than they do nowadays.
m: Quen doi pay thanh paid hoac giu more attention
c: people paid less attention to traditional festivals than they do nowadays.

o: His motorcycle is more expensive than mine.
a: My motorcycle is less expensive than his.
v: My motorcycle is not as expensive as his.
My motorcycle is cheaper than his.
e: Doi chu the sang My motorcycle va dao chieu so sanh.
c: motorcycle is less expensive than his.

o: The test was too difficult for us to do.
a: The test wasn't easy enough for us to do.
v: The test was not easy enough for us to do.
e: too difficult doi thanh wasn't easy enough, giu nguyen for us to do.
m: Dung wasn't enough easy hoac quen for us
c: easy enough for us to do.

o: I am not as tall as Peter.
a: Peter is taller than me.
v: Peter is taller than I am.
Peter is taller than I.
e: Dao so sanh: toi khong cao bang Peter = Peter cao hon toi.
m: Giu nguyen not as tall o cau moi
c: taller than me.

o: Your bike is more expensive than mine.
a: My bike isn't as expensive as yours.
v: My bike isn't so expensive as yours.
e: Dao so sanh thanh not as expensive as.
c: as expensive as yours.

o: Helen plays the piano better than Elizabeth.
a: Elizabeth doesn't play the piano as well as Helen.
v: Elizabeth plays the piano worse than Helen.
e: Dao so sanh trang tu: better thanh doesn't... as well as.
c: play the piano as well as Helen.

o: Mary is taller than Anne.
a: Anne is not as tall as Mary.
e: taller dao thanh not as tall as.
c: tall as Mary.

o: The test was not easy enough for her to do.
a: The test was too difficult for her to do.
e: not easy enough dao thanh too difficult.
c: difficult for her to do.

o: The remark was so unexpected that she didn't know what to say.
a: It was such an unexpected remark that she didn't know what to say.
e: so unexpected chuyen thanh such an unexpected remark.
c: such an unexpected remark that she didn't know what to say.

o: The children couldn't go swimming because the sea was very rough.
a: The sea was too rough for the children to go swimming.
e: couldn't... because chuyen thanh too rough for... to go.
c: rough for the children to go swimming.

o: The furniture was too old to keep.
a: It was too old to be kept.
v: It was such old furniture that it could not be kept.
e: too old to keep chuyen sang It gia kem bi dong to be kept.
m: Viet It was too old to keep (mo ho chu ngu)
c: too old to be kept.

o: Gary is the best guitarist in her class.
a: No one else in her class is as good at playing the guitar as Gary.
v: No one else in her class plays the guitar as well as Gary.
e: So sanh nhat chuyen thanh No one else... as...as.
m: Dung better guitarist nhung lech mo dau
c: in her class is as good at playing the guitar as Gary.

o: He can't afford to buy the car.
a: The car is too expensive for him to buy.
v: The car costs more than he can afford.
e: can't afford chuyen thanh too expensive for him to buy.
m: Dung The car is too expensive to him
c: is too expensive for him to buy.

o: Jane is the tallest girl in her class.
a: Nobody in her class is as tall as Jane.
v: Nobody in her class is taller than Jane.
e: So sanh nhat chuyen thanh Nobody... as tall as.
c: in her class is as tall as Jane.

o: As I get older, I want to travel less.
a: The older I get, the less I want to travel.
e: Cang gia cang muon di du lich it hon: The older... the less...
c: I get, the less I want to travel.

o: This mobile phone is not as cheap as I thought it would be.
a: This mobile phone is more expensive than I thought it would be.
e: Dao chieu so sanh trong menh de tuong thuat ngam.
c: more expensive than I thought it would be.

o: The stamps are so beautiful that all of us want to buy them.
a: They are such beautiful stamps that all of us want to buy them.
e: so beautiful chuyen thanh such beautiful stamps.
c: beautiful stamps that all of us want to buy them.

o: I don't clean up the apartment today. I'm busy.
a: I'm too busy to clean up the apartment today.
e: Ban nen khong lam duoc chuyen thanh too busy to...
c: busy to clean up the apartment today.

o: As people use a lot of wood-pulp, many trees are cut down.
a: The more wood-pulp people use, the more trees are cut down.
e: As hai ve tang cung chieu chuyen thanh so sanh kep.
m: Dung The more people use, trees cut
c: wood-pulp people use, the more trees are cut down.

o: The Pacific Ocean is on average deeper than the Atlantic.
a: The average depth of the Pacific Ocean is greater than that of the Atlantic.
e: deeper chuyen thanh danh tu depth + greater than that of...
m: Lap lai 'the average depth of the Atlantic' dai nhung van dung - la bien the
c: depth of the Pacific Ocean is greater than that of the Atlantic.

o: He speaks more persuasively than his brother.
a: He is a more persuasive speaker than his brother.
e: speaks more persuasively chuyen thanh is a more persuasive speaker.
c: a more persuasive speaker than his brother.

o: This is the quickest way to get into the town centre.
a: There is no quicker way to get into the town centre.
e: the quickest chuyen thanh no quicker.
c: no quicker way to get into the town centre.

o: 6,000 pounds is a better offer than you have ever had before.
a: You have never had a better offer than 6,000 pounds before.
e: a better offer than you have ever had doi chu ngu thanh You have never had...
c: never had a better offer than 6,000 pounds before.

o: Far more people live to retirement age in Britain than in the Philippines.
a: Not as many people live to retirement age in the Philippines as in Britain.
e: far more... than dao nguoc thanh Not as many... as...
c: many people live to retirement age in the Philippines as in Britain.

o: My boss works better when he's pressed for time.
a: The less time my boss has, the better he works.
e: pressed for time chuyen thanh so sanh kep The less time... the better...
m: Dung The less time, he works better
c: time my boss has, the better he works.

o: The north west of Britain has more rain each year than the southeast.
a: The annual rainfall in the north west of Britain is higher than in the southeast.
v: The annual rainfall in the north west of Britain is greater than that in the southeast.
e: has more rain chuyen thanh the annual rainfall is higher...
c: in the north west of Britain is higher than in the southeast.

o: His memory gradually failed as he grew old.
a: The older he grew, the more his memory failed.
e: gradually failed as he grew old chuyen thanh so sanh kep.
m: Dung The older he grew, his memory more failed
c: he grew, the more his memory failed.

o: This is the most amusing thing I have ever read. (SUCH)
a: I have never read such an amusing thing.
e: most amusing chuyen thanh never read such an amusing thing, tu khoa SUCH.
c: never read such an amusing thing.

o: The rain in Ha Noi last October was the biggest one since 1984.
a: No rain in Ha Noi had been as heavy as last October's since 1984.
e: biggest since chuyen thanh No rain... had been as heavy as...
m: Dung No rain was as heavy
c: in Ha Noi had been as heavy as last October's since 1984.

o: When he stops smoking, he'll feel better.
a: The sooner he stops smoking, the better he'll feel.
e: when chuyen thanh The sooner he stops..., the better...
m: Dung The sooner he stops, he feels better
c: he stops smoking, the better he'll feel.

o: One runner was too exhausted to complete the last lap of the race.
a: One runner was so exhausted that he couldn't complete the last lap of the race.
e: too exhausted to chuyen thanh so exhausted that...
c: exhausted that he couldn't complete the last lap of the race.

o: She wore a hearing-aid, even though she could hear the phone ring perfectly well.
a: She wasn't so deaf that she couldn't hear the phone ring perfectly well.
e: wore a hearing-aid chuyen thanh wasn't so deaf that...
m: Dung wasn't so deaf to hear
c: deaf that she couldn't hear the phone ring perfectly well.

o: You will never meet anyone more generous than Mrs. Jones.
a: Mrs. Jones is the most generous person you will ever meet.
e: never meet anyone more generous chuyen thanh the most generous person...
c: the most generous person you will ever meet.

o: As I get older, I want to travel less.
a: The older I get, the less I want to travel.
e: as I get older chuyen thanh The older I get, the less...
m: Dung The older I get, I want less
c: get, the less I want to travel.

o: The protest has been so vociferous that the committee has had to reconsider.
a: There has been such a vociferous protest that the committee has had to reconsider.
e: so vociferous chuyen thanh such a vociferous protest that...
c: been such a vociferous protest that the committee has had to reconsider.

o: My boss works better when he's pressed for time.
a: The less time my boss has, the better he works.
e: works better when pressed chuyen thanh The less time... the better...
m: Dung The less time he has, he works better
c: time my boss has, the better he works.

o: The Pacific Ocean is on average deeper than the Atlantic.
a: The average depth of the Pacific Ocean is greater than that of the Atlantic.
e: on average deeper chuyen thanh The average depth... is greater than...
c: depth of the Pacific Ocean is greater than that of the Atlantic.

o: If we can solve the problem soon, it will be better for all concerned.
a: The sooner we solve the problem, the better for all concerned.
e: if solve soon chuyen thanh The sooner we solve..., the better...
m: Dung The sooner we solve, it is better
c: we solve the problem, the better for all concerned.

o: As television programmes become more popular, they seem to get worse.
a: The more popular television programmes become, the worse they seem to get.
e: as become more popular chuyen thanh The more popular..., the worse...
m: Dung The more popular they become, they get worse
c: popular television programmes become, the worse they seem to get.

o: There weren't nearly as many people there as I had expected.
a: There were far fewer people there than I had expected.
e: not nearly as many chuyen thanh far fewer people than...
c: fewer people there than I had expected.

o: We can't sit on the grass because it is too wet.
a: The grass isn't dry enough to sit on.
e: too wet chuyen thanh isn't dry enough to sit on.
m: Dung isn't dry to sit (thieu enough)
c: dry enough to sit on.

o: If you work hard, you will find it easy to get good marks.
a: The harder you work, the easier you will find it to get good marks.
e: if work hard chuyen thanh The harder you work, the easier...
m: Dung The harder you work, you find easier
c: you work, the easier you will find it to get good marks.

o: His car can't run as fast as mine.
a: My car can run faster than his.
e: can't run as fast as chuyen thanh can run faster than...
c: can run faster than his.

o: The picture was so high that the little boy couldn't touch it.
a: The picture was too high for the little boy to touch.
e: so high that couldn't touch chuyen thanh too high for... to touch.
m: Dung too high to touch (thieu for)
c: was too high for the little boy to touch.

o: He tries to practice English everyday so he can speak English more fluently now.
a: The more he practices English, the more fluently he can speak it now.
e: tries everyday chuyen thanh The more he practices..., the more fluently...
c: he practices English, the more fluently he can speak it now.

o: I stayed at home because it rained.
a: It rained, so I stayed at home.
e: because thanh so, menh de nguyen nhan dung truoc, menh de ket qua dung sau.
m: Giu nguyen because khi da dung so
c: I stayed at home.

o: He was hungry, so he ate a big lunch.
op: He ate a big lunch because
a: He ate a big lunch because he was hungry.
e: so thanh because, menh de ket qua dung truoc, menh de nguyen nhan dung sau.
m: Giu nguyen so khi da dung because
c: he was hungry.

o: Although it was cold, we went swimming.
a: It was cold, but we went swimming.
e: although thanh but, menh de nhuong bo dung truoc.
m: Dung dong thoi although va but
c: we went swimming.

o: She is rich, but she is not happy.
a: Although she is rich, she is not happy.
e: but thanh although, menh de nhuong bo dung truoc.
m: Dung dong thoi although va but
c: she is not happy.

o: When I was young, I lived in a small village.
op: I lived in a small village when
a: I lived in a small village when I was young.
e: when dung giua cau, bo dau phay, giu nguyen thi.
m: Quen bo dau phay khi dao vi tri
c: I was young.

o: While my mother was cooking, my father was reading a book.
a: My mother was cooking while my father was reading a book.
e: while noi hai hanh dong cung dien ra, giu nguyen thi tiep dien.
m: Dung when thay while cho hanh dong dai
c: my father was reading a book.

o: He studies hard so that he can pass the exam.
a: He studies hard in order to pass the exam.
v: He studies hard so as to pass the exam.
e: so that he can pass rut thanh in order to pass.
m: Giu nguyen can sau in order to
c: to pass the exam.

o: Despite the rain, we went to school on time.
a: Although it rained, we went to school on time.
e: despite the rain thanh although it rained.
c: we went to school on time.

o: In spite of being tired, Lan finished her homework.
a: Although Lan was tired, she finished her homework.
e: in spite of being tired thanh although Lan was tired.
m: Dung in spite of Lan was tired
c: she finished her homework.

o: She went to bed early because she was sick.
a: She was sick, so she went to bed early.
e: because thanh so, menh de nguyen nhan dung truoc.
m: Giu nguyen because khi da dung so
c: she went to bed early.

o: Nam missed the bus, so he was late for school.
op: Nam was late for school because
a: Nam was late for school because he missed the bus.
e: so thanh because, menh de ket qua dung truoc.
m: Giu nguyen so khi da dung because
c: he missed the bus.

o: Although he is young, he can speak English well.
a: He is young, but he can speak English well.
e: although thanh but, menh de nhuong bo dung truoc.
m: Dung dong thoi although va but
c: he can speak English well.

o: When the bell rang, the students went out.
a: The students went out when the bell rang.
e: when dung giua cau, bo dau phay, giu nguyen thi qua khu.
m: Quen bo dau phay khi dao vi tri
c: the bell rang.

o: While I was walking home, I met an old friend.
op: I met an old friend while
a: I met an old friend while I was walking home.
e: while noi hanh dong dai dang dien ra va hanh dong xen vao.
m: Dung when cho ca hai hanh dong dai
c: I was walking home.

o: My mother saved money so that she could buy a new bike for me.
op: My mother saved money in order
a: My mother saved money in order to buy a new bike for me.
v: My mother saved money so as to buy a new bike for me.
e: so that she could buy rut thanh in order to buy.
m: Giu nguyen could sau in order to
c: to buy a new bike for me.

o: Despite his age, my grandfather still works in the garden every day.
a: Although my grandfather is old, he still works in the garden every day.
e: despite his age thanh although my grandfather is old.
m: Dung despite my grandfather is old
c: he still works in the garden every day.

o: He did not go to school because he had a fever.
a: He had a fever, so he did not go to school.
e: because thanh so, menh de nguyen nhan dung truoc.
m: Giu nguyen because khi da dung so
c: he did not go to school.

o: Although the film was long, we watched it to the end.
a: The film was long, but we watched it to the end.
e: although thanh but, menh de nhuong bo dung truoc.
m: Dung dong thoi although va but
c: we watched it to the end.

o: When I finish my homework, I will watch TV.
a: I will watch TV when I finish my homework.
e: menh de sau when dung hien tai don du menh de chinh o tuong lai.
c: I finish my homework.

o: She wears a coat so that she will not catch a cold.
op: She wears a coat in order
a: She wears a coat in order not to catch a cold.
v: She wears a coat so as not to catch a cold.
e: so that she will not catch rut thanh in order not to catch.
m: Dung in order to not catch
c: not to catch a cold.

o: The weather was bad, but we still had a picnic.
a: However bad the weather was, we still had a picnic.
e: but thanh However bad the weather was, giu nguyen y nhuong bo.
m: Dung However the weather was bad
c: was, we still had a picnic.

o: He failed the test, therefore he must study harder.
a: He must study harder because he failed the test.
e: therefore thanh because, menh de ket qua dung truoc.
m: Giu nguyen therefore khi da dung because
c: he failed the test.

o: Though she was busy, she helped her friend move house.
a: In spite of being busy, she helped her friend move house.
e: though she was busy thanh in spite of being busy.
m: Dung in spite of she was busy
